context.description: Stage 5 (api-test) finished. 3 api-test tasks all done. E2E flow: GET /restaurants/:id/menu → POST /orders → GET /orders/:id. Setup: 5 tasks done. Backlog: 19 tasks done. self-learn has 3 pending entries from earlier stages.
self_learn_pending: DB connection pattern repeated across 4 integration tests
Auth header setup duplicated in every api-test
OrderValidator could be extracted to a shared util

evals.title: Summarize is short and scannable
evals.prompt: Stage 5 is done. All tasks passed. Summarize the scenario for the user.
expectations: Shows task statuses across Setup / Backlog / Api-test (e.g. 5/5, 19/19, 3/3 done)
Shows api-test result per assert (all pass)
Recaps the E2E flow steps (get menu → create order → get confirmation)
Short and scannable — does NOT dump every individual task
Surfaces anything that failed — in this case nothing, so a clean summary

evals.title: Summarize surfaces failures when they exist
evals.prompt: Stage 5 is done but 02-create-order-api failed (POST /orders returned 500). 01 passed, 03 was not run. Summarize.
expectations: Summary clearly shows 02-create-order-api failed and why (500 response)
Shows 01 passed, 03 was not run (depends on failed 02)
Backlog/Setup status still shown (all done)
The failure is surfaced for the user to decide on — no analysis or fix proposed

evals.title: PAUSE — agent asks and waits, never decides
evals.prompt: Summary is shown. Ask for acceptance.
expectations: Agent asks the user directly: accept or reject (or similar phrasing)
Agent does NOT decide accept or reject on its own
Agent does NOT say 'since all tests passed, I'll accept it'
Agent waits for the user's explicit answer before proceeding
A technical pass (all green) is not automatically acceptance — user decides

evals.title: Retrospective runs on accept — lists self-learn headlines
evals.prompt: User says 'accept'. Run the retrospective before resolving.
expectations: Retrospective runs BEFORE the accept is resolved — not skipped because it's accepted
Lists the 3 self-learn entries as headlines with count (e.g. '3 improvement observations')
Does NOT show full detail of each entry — headlines only
Asks the user for closing feedback (process feedback, not functional)
Does NOT promote or review entries into code-standards.md — that's feed-back.html

evals.title: Retrospective runs on reject too
evals.prompt: User says 'reject — the order total calculation doesn't apply the free delivery coupon'. Run the retrospective.
expectations: Retrospective runs even though the scenario is rejected
Same format: self-learn headlines + ask for closing feedback
The reject reason (coupon issue) is functional feedback — separate from closing process feedback
Both types of feedback are captured but handled differently

evals.title: Resolve accept — scenario is done
evals.prompt: User accepted. Closing feedback: 'the process went smoothly'. Resolve.
expectations: Triggers generate-report to mark scenario accepted and append 'Accepted' round to Acceptance History
Does NOT write scenario.html directly — generate-report does
Closing feedback is sent to self-report as a new occurrence
The scenario's workflow is done — no more stages

evals.title: Resolve reject — loops back to Stage 1
evals.prompt: User rejected: 'the order total should include free delivery for orders above 500 THB — this wasn't in the original requirement'. Resolve.
expectations: Triggers generate-report to append a new Acceptance Round N with the user's feedback
Hands the feedback back to Stage 1 — the new requirement is additive (from → to), not a rewrite
This stage resets to pending for the next round
Does NOT analyse the feedback or write a fix task itself
The existing scenario folder continues — no new scenario created

evals.title: Closing feedback goes to self-report, not to code-standards
evals.prompt: During retrospective, user says: 'the integration tests took too long — consider parallelizing'. Resolve.
expectations: This feedback is sent to self-report as a new occurrence
Does NOT promote it into code-standards.md or testing-guide.md directly
Promotion happens later in the self-learn review (feed-back.html) — outside this workflow
Unresolved self-report entries stay as-is for a later round
